incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated cache read errors and prefix miss spikes in us-west-2 (affecting inference paths). paging oncall.

Aisha (oncall): I'm on it, ack. seeing 6xx on backend reads and KV miss rate jumped from 3% -> 22% last 5m.

Ravi (eng-runtime): Confirmed. Hot prefixes for some tenants are causing heavy paging. Prefetch queue is also spiking CPU.

Marta (sre): Any customer-facing errors? Helen (cs) can you surface any customer reports?

Helen (cs): Two enterprise customers reported latency/timeouts in the last 10m, CS flagged high priority tickets.

Aisha (oncall): Initial mitigation plan: 1) apply tenant-level rate cap on top callers, 2) disable prefetch for affected prefixes, 3) enable correctness-forwarding (bypass cache reads) for suspect prefixes to avoid stale-cache correctness issues.

Ravi (eng-runtime): Agreed. Rolling a soft rate limit first. Command I ran: ```sh
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/ops/traffic-shape -d '{"tenant":"tenant-acme","qps":40}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

Tom (eng-db): Added a KV read-only bypass rule for prefixes starting with `acme-prod/` to force origin reads for correctness while we evaluate. Command: ```sh
redwoodctl cache bypass create --prefix "acme-prod/" --reason "correctness during spike"````

Marta (sre): Prefetch disabled for the region: ```sh
redwoodctl prefetch set --region us-west-2 --state disabled --note "emergency throttle"
```

Aisha (oncall): Monitoring: miss rate down slightly but overall latency still high. Doing staged quota trims for top 5 callers (10-30% trims).

Ravi (eng-runtime): We've also enabled short TTL for prefix entries to reduce cache churn: `ttl_override=10s` for hot keys.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: runtime-config changed (prefetch=disabled, ttl_override active) by Marta. No code deploys.

Marta (sre): Quick health check: 1) 5m p95 latency dropped from 1.8s -> 1.2s after rate caps, 2) backend 5xxs fell by ~40%. Still watching.

Helen (cs): Notified impacted customers with ETA ~30m for full mitigation. Keeping them updated.

Aisha (oncall): Next steps: keep bypass+rate caps for 30m, gather traces for a sample tenant, attempt controlled prefetch pilot with stricter concurrency limits once stable. If things worsen, escalate to infra pager.

Ravi (eng-runtime): Will collect KV traces and submit an eval run to check prefetch correctness regressions. Posting trace snippet shortly.

Tom (eng-db): Creating a short-lived metric dashboard for prefixes we've bypassed and the top callers trimmed.

Aisha (oncall): Handing off monitoring to Marta in 25m. If any customer escalations arrive, tag me and ops. Closing initial mitigation loop here.

ops-bot: Handoff note: oncall change scheduled. Aisha -> Marta in 25 minutes. Pagerduty incident ID PD-88221 attached.

Marta (sre): I have it. Will keep this thread updated with any rollback or further actions. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
